[[File:Gauntlet_gang.png|thumb|The Gauntlet gang]]
The '''Gauntlet''' was a criminal gang that set up death duel tournaments in the [[Red Light Sector (Nar Shaddaa)|Red Light Sector]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]]. While refugees ran through deadly ordeals for rewards, the Gauntlet broadcast the holos of it for profit.
